title: TemporalEventChain
description: Stage C output. Allen-relation-scored temporal links between prior component events and the emergent activity. Answers the key causal question: did prior degradation, maintenance, or failures PRECEDE or OVERLAP with this emergent activity? Produced by adapting the TSKR temporal scorer from the RCA pipeline to component event timelines.

component_id.description: Component for which the event chain was constructed. Matches ComponentEventTimeline.component_id.

emergent_activity_interval.description: The temporal interval of the emergent activity, used as the reference for all Allen relation computations.

is_point_event.description: True if only a detection timestamp is known, not a duration interval.

chain_links.description: One entry per prior event that was evaluated for temporal relationship to the emergent activity.

allen_relation.description: Allen interval relation of the prior event relative to the emergent activity interval. precedes: prior event ended before emergent activity started (classic lead-time signal). overlaps: prior event started before and was still active at onset — strongest causal signal. contains: long-running degradation encompasses the whole emergent activity window. during: prior event appeared after onset — likely a symptom, not a cause. follows: prior event is post-activity — temporal contradiction.

relation_score.description: Causal relevance score for this Allen relation. Approximate reference values: overlaps=0.90, contains=0.85, precedes=0.75, simultaneous=0.50, during=0.30, follows=0.10.

onset_lag_hours.description: Time between prior event onset and emergent activity onset, in hours. Negative values indicate the prior event started after the emergent activity.

duration_hours.description: Duration of the prior event in hours, if known.

causal_strength.description: Qualitative causal strength label derived from Allen relation and confidence.

confidence.description: Confidence in this link, accounting for data quality of both events.

evidence_text.description: Relevant text snippet from the prior event that supports the causal link.

issue_class_match.description: True if the prior event's issue class matches the emergent activity's symptom signature.

strongest_link_id.description: link_id of the chain link with the highest relation_score.

has_temporal_contradiction.description: True if any link has allen_relation=follows, indicating a potential data quality issue or that the prior event is actually a downstream consequence.

causal_posture.description: Overall assessment of whether the component event history supports a causal chain leading to this emergent activity.

epsilon_hours.description: Epsilon tolerance used in Allen relation boundary comparisons.
